Start from a blinking cursor. Bootline hands you MorrowDesk, a small fictional personal computer, and a neighborhood of people who need things made on it. Draw a badge, save it as a picture, set it as your wallpaper, attach it to a mail, publish it on your home page. Everything you make stays on your machine, and the machine slowly becomes yours.

Everything in Bootline is fictional and local. No real drive, operating system, network or account is ever changed.

Get ready to enter a magical library where even the paths can disappear! In Owlbound Tomes, you follow a small owl librarian on a mission to recover runaway magical books, deliver them to the correct Book Return Tables, and finally reach her cozy perch.

But there is one important detail: the paths are not permanent. Some tiles collapse after one passage, others survive two, while special tiles can withstand up to three crossings. Every movement must be planned carefully, because a path used too early may simply disappear when you need it most.

Before starting, study the board, connect the paths, arrange the movable tiles, and think about the best order for collecting and returning each book. Once you press Play, there is no way to change the route. The owl will automatically follow the path you created, carrying multiple books and turning every crossing into a strategic decision.

Across 30 levels, divided into three magical biomes, the challenges become increasingly creative and require you to think not only about where to go, but also when to pass through each location. Can you make a round trip without destroying the path you need to return?

With a cozy atmosphere, charming visuals, and puzzles based on spatial planning, Owlbound Tomes delivers calm, clever, and deeply satisfying challenges. Observe, organize, calculate your passages, and create the perfect route for the little librarian.

Recover the books, preserve the paths, and find the perfect perch!

Panda: Shards of Aurora is a challenging platformer set in a frozen world trapped in an endless winter.

Take control of a young panda and embark on a journey across 30 handcrafted levels, guided by the mysterious Ancient Bear, an ancient guardian who will help you uncover the secrets of the frozen valley.

Navigate icy platforms, slippery surfaces, deadly spikes, fragile terrain, and dangerous environmental hazards as you search for the legendary Shards of Aurora.

But the frozen lands are not empty. Hostile penguins and aggressive seals stand in your way, testing your reflexes and precision as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

Explore every corner of the frozen world, discover hidden gems, overcome challenging obstacles, and restore the Shards of Aurora to bring the light back to the valley.

Air Race Assault is an arcade air racing game that blends high-speed flight with aerial combat. Pilot agile aircraft through obstacle-filled tracks featuring dangerous curves, alternate routes, and dynamic scenery while engaging opponents in mid-air dogfights. Use machine guns, missiles, and mines to attack rivals, while shields and repairs provide tactical defense. Manage boosters strategically, discover shortcuts, and outmaneuver competitors across three difficulty levels and multiple game modes—Championship, Arcade, and Time Trial. Local split-screen multiplayer lets you compete head-to-head on the same console, and progression unlocks new content and tracks as you climb the leaderboard.

Darkness has swallowed the land. Only one unlikely hero is brave enough to fight back.
Shadow Cat is a focused 2D action-platformer that puts you in control of a fearless cat boy on a mission to save a world overrun by evil creatures. Run, jump, and dash through 25 handcrafted levels set across dark forests, abandoned factories, dangerous caves, and forgotten tunnels.
Straightforward controls make it easy to begin, but every new stage introduces more demanding platforming challenges. Time your jumps, dash across deadly gaps, avoid spikes and moving hazards, and launch fireballs to defeat the creatures standing in your way.
Explore each level to collect life points and replenish your fireball ammo. Activate checkpoints to protect your progress when danger strikes. Taking damage costs one life and returns you to the latest checkpoint—but lose every life, and the level must be faced again from the beginning.
The journey becomes more dangerous as new enemies, traps, and environmental threats test your timing, awareness, and resource management. Master your movement, use your fireballs wisely, and keep pushing forward until the final confrontation with a giant spider and its relentless minions.

Welcome aboard Flight ROSE-204. It should have been an ordinary flight. Then the cabin starts to break apart.

Attention, Dear Passengers is a single-player, physics-driven survival game where every round turns a routine flight into a fight to stay upright. Brace in your seat, move through a collapsing cabin, avoid dangerous debris, and keep going after the wreck hits the ground.

You are not alone. Six AI passengers react to the disaster around them: some seek safety, some panic, and some make a bad situation worse. Grab a passenger when the moment calls for it, pull them from danger, or fight to keep your own footing while the world shifts beneath you.

Each flight uses fresh random seeds for its disaster events. Lightning, ruptures, decompression, floods, fire, acid rain, aftershocks, and tornadoes can reshape the round and force a new survival plan.

Get ready for an adventure packed with jumps, bubbles, and creativity in Bubble Stomp! Here, every obstacle is an opportunity to test your skills and discover new ways to move through stages filled with exciting platforming challenges.

Use temporary bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons to reach impossible places, cross dangerous areas, and overcome increasingly challenging obstacles. Combine these mechanics in unexpected ways to create new paths, gain momentum, defeat enemies, and reach the final objective.

Across 30 levels, new enemies, hazards, and mechanics are gradually introduced, making every stage bring a new surprise. Breakable platforms, cannons, obstacles, enemies, and optional collectibles fill the environments with possibilities to explore.

Checkpoints help you continue your adventure without losing all your progress, while collectibles scattered throughout the levels encourage players who want to explore every corner and completely master the challenges.

Observe the environment, plan your next move, create a bubble, use Ground Pound, blast yourself from cannons, and discover how far your creativity can take you.

Jump, pop, smash, and master every level!

Open the doors to a warm storybook atelier and turn every customer request into a finished garment. Accept a commission, choose the right material, sketch a design, arrange pattern pieces with the grain, cut the fabric, pin it to the mannequin, sew each seam, add decorations, and deliver your work.

Build a season from 12 garment projects, 16 fabrics, varied colors and patterns, and 10 client profiles with different tastes. Match fabrics and trims to each brief, balance cost against quality, earn money and reputation, keep favorite creations in the wardrobe, and care for Marmalade, the atelier cat.

Every production stage is designed for controller play, including precise pattern cutting. Keyboard and mouse are also supported. Versioned local autosave, Continue, pause, clear back actions, and a complete season flow make this a full cozy crafting game rather than a limited demo.

Get ready to get your hands dirty and let your creativity bloom in Fit and Grow, a relaxing puzzle game where every planted piece can completely transform the board!

Here, seeds and watering cans work together to create something bigger. Place the pieces carefully, make the plants grow, and watch as they expand into new spaces across the board. But be careful: the more your plants grow, the less space remains for your next moves. Planning the right moment to plant and water will be essential to finding the perfect solution!

Across 30 levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new board shapes and piece combinations will put your spatial reasoning to the test. Each stage brings a small challenge to solve, encouraging you to think several moves ahead and discover how the growth of a single plant can completely change your possibilities.

And there is no need to be afraid of making mistakes! With Undo, Hint, and Restart always available, you can experiment with different strategies, undo a move, or get a little help when the solution seems hidden among the leaves.

There are no timers, pressure, or rushing. Just you, your pieces, and a board waiting to bloom.

Observe the space, plan your moves, plant your seeds, position your watering cans, and discover the perfect combination to fill every corner.

Plant with strategy, water with intelligence, and make every level bloom!

The ghosts have taken over the building. Do you have what it takes to drive them all out?

In Pop the Ghosts, you take on the role of a paranormal hunter armed with a special gun. Explore a haunted building, face different types of ghosts, and overcome challenges that become increasingly difficult.

Take on a campaign with 30 platform-style levels, run, jump, break boxes, and explore the environments to find your way to the enemies. Eliminate all the ghosts to advance, but stay alert: some enemies require more than one shot to defeat.

Find TVs to activate checkpoints and watch out for traps scattered throughout the environment, such as dangerous drops of acid falling from the ceiling. Take two hits and you will return to the beginning of the level or to the last checkpoint.

Dozens of engaging single-screen sliding puzzles! Retro goodness! Crazy contraptions to master!

Anyone can play Retro Cube Slider, just press the direction button and let the stylish neon cube slide away!

Runes Quest is a sokoban-like puzzle game where you guide a knight through 30 levels across light and dark biomes on their journey home. Navigate rooms filled with interactive elements like buttons, grates, keys, runes, boxes, pits, and traps using logic and careful planning. Enjoy cute visuals and relaxing music as you solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles.

Get ready to think fast, plan carefully, and try not to become dinner in Sneak Cheese, a cozy and strategic puzzle game where a tiny mouse must push every piece of cheese into the burrows while trying to survive cats that are always ready to pounce!

Every move matters. Push the cheese through the environment, find the right path to the burrows, and turn every space on the board into part of your strategy. But don't think it will be that simple. With every valid move you make, the cats react too, and knowing exactly when they will move can mean the difference between a perfect escape and a disastrous capture!

You will encounter different types of cats, each with its own behavior. Some remain stationary but attack anything that appears directly in front of them. Others patrol the environment after every move you make, while the slower ones wait for the right moment to advance. Watch their routes, track their cycles, and plan every step before putting yourself in danger!

Across 30 handcrafted levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new challenges and increasingly clever combinations will put your reasoning to the test. You will need to figure out the right order for pushing the cheese, avoid getting trapped, predict the cats' movements, and make sure the little mouse stays alive until the final piece of cheese reaches its destination.

Find the Needle: One in Ten Million
Find one needle in ten million strands of straw. Gather by hand, build an automated workshop, and follow the needle through your production lines.

Cargo Delivery Simulator is a relaxed delivery game where you ride motorcycles through a 3D city, completing 10 timed routes with multiple stops while managing fuel and meeting deadlines. Earn credits from successful deliveries to unlock new bikes from a garage of 11 motorcycles, each with its own handling. Navigate using clear route guidance, monitor your fuel and time with a motorcycle-inspired interface, and enjoy a laid-back urban soundtrack as you progress through increasingly complex delivery assignments.

A once-thriving city has become a dangerous battlefield. Hostile forces control the streets, armed enemies patrol the urban districts, and every mission brings a new threat. When the red protocol is activated, there is only one objective: enter the city, complete your mission, and survive.

Dead City: Red Protocol is a third-person action shooter focused on urban combat, exploration, missions, vehicles, and intense encounters.

Explore a large city environment filled with streets, buildings, traffic, enemy-controlled areas, and hidden locations. Move through the city on foot or take control of different vehicles as you travel between objectives.

Engage enemies using a variety of weapons and combat tactics. Fight through dangerous streets, respond to hostile attacks, complete missions, and navigate an urban environment where danger can appear at any moment.

An accident has transformed Mia into an adorable little cat, and now she must find a way to return to her human form. Guided by the enigmatic Cat God, Mia embarks on an enchanting journey filled with puzzles, souls, and discoveries!

In Mia's Journey, you will face 32 carefully crafted levels, where each challenge requires you to push souls across the environment and place each one on the purifying altars to progress. Sounds simple? Not quite! Every move can completely change the path, and if you're not careful, you may end up trapping a soul or blocking your own way.

As Mia moves forward, the challenges become increasingly creative, requiring observation, planning, and plenty of brainpower. Think before you act, find the perfect sequence of moves, and discover how to overcome each puzzle without leaving a single soul behind.

But the adventure doesn't take place only on the puzzle board. Between challenges, charming cutscenes reveal more about Mia's story and her relationship with the mysterious Cat God. Find out more and help Mia return to her human form.

With cozy visuals, Mia's Journey offers a comfortable adventure that is easy to learn, yet capable of challenging even the most dedicated puzzle fans.

The ultimate test of reflexes and nerves!
A giant, unstoppable rolling stone is breathing down your neck, and there’s only one golden rule to survive: never look back!
Dive headfirst into Stone Run, a fast-paced, hand-drawn retro arcade experience designed for non-stop adrenaline and pure fun. Outrun disaster, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and push your reaction speed to the absolute limit in a beautifully crafted world that feels like an interactive cartoon.

Kawaii Push is a casual and relaxing Sokoban-style game in which players must push boxes to the correct locations.
The protagonist is a red-haired girl who explores cute and colorful anime-style environments.
With moderately challenging puzzles, the game offers a fun and accessible experience for players of all ages.

Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!

Help the crafty pink-haired gearhead complete a series of intricate puzzles in a beautiful pixel art world! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems!

Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard. Can you help the tiny techie beat puzzle land?

Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

Dungeon Quest is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on exploration, precision, combat, and challenging dungeon environments. Players take full control of the character as they run, jump, dash, overcome deadly traps, defeat enemies, and interact with different mechanisms to progress through each stage. Across 40 handcrafted levels, new mechanics and increasingly challenging situations are gradually introduced, keeping the experience varied while rewarding players who master movement, combat, and the game's different environmental challenges.

Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a heartfelt spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and a lifetime shared together. Restore Riku’s fading memories across 21 illustrated chapters, solo or in local co-op.

The forest near the kingdom has become overrun with trolls, and only one brave knight stands between them and the kingdom.

Take up your sword and venture into the forest in this simple and challenging 2D pixel art platformer. Jump across dangerous terrain, avoid deadly hazards, and fight different types of trolls standing in your way.

Each troll has its own behavior and abilities, requiring you to learn their patterns and choose the right moment to strike.

Solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive. Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up. Start with quick 5x5 grids and work your way up to 15x15 monsters.

It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.

Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.

Take control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together.

Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage.

Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge.

But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. In this strange world, nature has found a way to thrive among gears, metal and forgotten mechanisms — and this little robot is living proof that the two can grow together.

Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference!

Switch between the two characters to take advantage of their positions, create paths, and complete each puzzle. While one candle is active, the other remains still and can even be pushed like any other object in the environment. Use both wisely, plan your moves, and avoid wasting precious steps too soon!

As you progress, new challenges make the puzzles increasingly complex. Pressure plates, stone barriers, and other obstacles require precise movements, careful planning, and perfect coordination between the two candles.

Pixel Solo Ops is a retro-inspired 2D action-platformer. After a covert mission goes wrong, your closest comrade is captured by a ruthless military faction. Fight through enemy troops, infiltrate fortified bases, and survive intense pixel-art firefights to rescue him. With tight gunplay, fast-paced challenges, and nostalgic visuals, you’re the last hope. One soldier. One mission. No backup.

Jump, hack, and escape the facility!
Solve system puzzles and survive dangerous laser traps in CyberBot — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to override the security networks and find your way out.

Grab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled!

Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions.

Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be!

Get ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination. But be careful: the available pieces aren't enough to complete the entire route, so you'll need to think beyond the tracks!

On a hexagonal grid, select, rotate, and reposition pieces to build the perfect route. Along the way, you'll find swap tiles that let you assign colors to tracks or empty spaces. When the train passes over them, their positions are swapped, transforming the board and revealing new possibilities for continuing the journey.

Get ready for a sneaky adventure in Sneaky Purr! Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level. But be careful: escaping with the loot can be much harder than it looks!

Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow. Observe the environment, choose the right elements, and build a safe route to reach the objective!

In each level, you begin in planning mode, observing the character's position, the obstacles, and all the available possibilities. Use the cursor to select and place elements such as springs, wind, and platforms, creating the perfect path for the platypus. When you're satisfied with your plan, press Play and watch your strategy come to life!

In execution mode, the platypus runs automatically, and you can no longer change the elements in the environment. It can hit walls and change direction, use springs, be carried by the wind, and cross platforms you placed earlier. But watch out for hazards! Pits, saws, and spikes restart the level, so every element needs to be in the right place.

Fall Adventure is a 2D pixel art platformer where you must find all the magical orbs to progress. As you descend deeper, the caves become larger and more challenging. All you have is a dash that keeps you in the air for a brief moment, allowing you to reach otherwise inaccessible areas throughout the levels.

Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth.

See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

Cat Pipes: More Meow is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game about guiding warmth to sleepy cats. Rotate the pipes to connect the flow from the main source to every cat in the room, then watch each one light up and purr.

With 51 handcrafted levels that ease you in and slowly grow into satisfying brain-teasers, portals that bend the path across the board, and a warm lo-fi atmosphere, it's the perfect little game to unwind with.

Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.

Bash & blast mutated creatures, restore infested gardens and defend the once-peaceful Bloomland in this frantic solo or local co-op action arcade game. Gather resources, grow flowers, feed animals, complete garden chores, and master handcrafted levels with adaptive difficulty.

Police Stories 2 is a cooperative tactical top-down police shooter.

The sequel to the iconic Police Stories will feature new challenges, new mechanics, and a brand-new story. Take command of a rundown precinct in the most crime-ridden part of the city. With limited resources, dangerous choices, and enemies on every side, the line between justice and compromise starts to blur.
Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Survive the system.

Amazing Frog? is a Hardcore Parkour openworld buffet of bonkers physics sandbox gameplay.
Welcome to the town of Swindon, SwindonShire. Home to flatulant super hero, Amazing Frog?
a 20Km Landscape A whole bunch of vehicles 4 player split screen Oculus VR support. Pigging backs… and pigs ridiculous ragdolls, trampolines, cannons and explosions Weapons like crossbows lasers and machine-guns Vicious Sharks Swimmming ish and Boats in the ocean Fully fitted Fart Gym Underground Zombie Frogs in the Sewers A Giant chessboard A bunch of test rooms and a whole lot of mystery...

We Are The Caretakers is an afrofuturist sci-fi squad management RPG. Recruit, train, and manage an arcane team of protectors to unite cultures and defend the endangered wildlife you rely on, after the massive energy barrier that separates you from a wider universe mysteriously falls.
Come Sacrifice Your Friends with eldritch weapons in chaotic environments dominated by the horrors of H.P. Lovecraft. Succumb to madness and be the last one alive!

Super Forklift 3000 is an arcade space shooter with a twist: you drive a forklift that carries and shoots up to three boxes. Defeat enemies and bosses while managing your different box types. Be careful not to run out of ammo!

Fragmented Minds explores the reality in which The Foundation fails to contain a breach after a cataclysmic XK-Scenario. You will awaken in the derelict depths of Mars Site-113 to discover what happened, and piece together the solution to the most devastating event humanity has ever seen.

Jump Space is a mission based co-op FPS for up to 4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Engage in intense battles both on the ground and in space, and always keep your ship upgraded and intact.
Science Simulator the science educational video game. explore, discover, learn.

Redfall is an open-world, co-op FPS from Arkane Austin, the award-winning team behind Prey and Dishonored. Continuing Arkane’s legacy of carefully crafted worlds and immersive sims, Redfall brings the studio’s signature gameplay to this story-driven action shooter.

Phantom Abyss is a massive asynchronous multiplayer game that casts players into procedurally-generated temples and tasks them with retrieving the sacred relics hidden within deadly chambers. Intrepid adventurers will dodge scores of hidden traps, leap treacherous chasms, and flee relentless guardians through branching paths until one of the relics are claimed or the devices of death overwhelm them. Be warned, you only get one attempt at each temple and failure or settling for a lesser relic means you will never see that temple again...

The cleverest players will use the phantom runs of failed attempts from other players to their advantage and avoid the missteps and mistakes that led to their doom. Once the legendary relic at the bottom of each temple is found, the temple goes away forever and becomes the priceless trophy of the skilled adventurer.

Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming exploration game with crafting, resource management and base building. Play 1-4 players in online co-op, discover and grow alien plants, domesticate wildlife, endure the elements and build your new home away from home.

Shoresy: Legends of the North brings the hit TV comedy series Shoresy (Hulu, Crave, Netflix, SBS) to life with a modern take on classic hockey video games. Enjoy fast-paced Sudbury Blueberry Bulldog hockey gameplay with hits, goals, fights, chirps and more.

Replaced is a 2.5D sci-fi retro-futuristic action platformer where you play as R.E.A.C.H. - an artificial intelligence trapped in a human body against its own will. Replaced combines cinematic platforming, pixel art and free-flow action combat set in an alternative 1980's.

Abeyance is a roguelite, sci-fi, dungeon-crawler. Salvage wrecked starships in a gritty, post-apocalyptic world. Fight mutants and mechanized defense systems. Battle your inner demons to save your soul… and reclaim your humanity.
In this Home Alone meets Doom fright fest, fight off Krampus on Christmas Eve, in a terrifying, double-barrel wielding, jump-scaring, thrill ride!

Let your childhood dreams come true and become a full-time train models collector! Buy vintage or modern trains and wagons. Paint them, use stickers, or even design them from a scratch! Then plan a landscape and lay tracks. And don't forget to charge the visitors for viewing your unique collection!

Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action mining game. Use the time between attacks to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and relics – deliver them back to your dome to unlock powerful upgrades and useful new gadgets.
But it won’t be long until the relentless monsters return - do you risk delving deeper into the mine? Or return to base and prepare for imminent attack? The choice is yours, but make it quickly!

Become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with Miasma. Discover the secret behind its appearance, grow plants to power up your spells, and use nature’s magic to heal the land. Build your very own homestead from the ground up. Discover new plants and tend to your ever-growing garden to heal the land and make it your own.

AirportSim is an Advanced Airport Ground Handling Simulator with true-to-life visuals and operations, licensed planes and vehicles, real airports and live weather conditions. Enjoy the many tasks alone or with friends, making this experience unforgettable.

Discover the beauty and fragility of life in Survivor Cells, a unique survival game against viruses and bacteria, which strategically combines the elements of roguelite, bullet hell and tower defense in a challenging experience. Your destiny depends on your agility and choices. How far will you get?

Build a nation and lead your people throughout history to the pinnacles of human achievement as you explore new lands, develop arts and culture, conduct diplomacy, and go head-to-head with your rivals to prove you are the greatest ruler ever known.

Featuring both familiar and innovative gameplay mechanics, Ara: History Untold delivers an evolution in historical grand strategy with no pre-set paths to victory, leading to endless possibilities. Your choices will define the world you create, your experience, and your legacy.

Play as a drummer seeking revenge on a Metal Band of Eldritch Monsters in this wacky roguelite brawler. Fight through hordes of enemies with only your drumsticks & drumming techniques as your weapons. Tap into the power of their music by finding corrupted music discs to increase your strength to defeat each of the band members. Are you good enough to escape the corrupted hellscape, once and for all?
An intense visual novel adventure based on real-life experiences! Choices that matter, multiple endings, 3+ hours of gameplay, OST, real-life career advice based on comprehensive research!

Sneak, steal, and shoot your way through a world of pulp adventure in The Lamplighters League! Globetrot across a variety of exciting locales around the world and outwit your enemies in strategic turn-based combat - and, if you play your cards right, you might just save the world.

A fast-paced action platformer, use your acrobatic skills to navigate through challenging levels. Swing and dash through a variety of obstacles to reach the end of each stage. With intuitive controls and thrilling gameplay, Dash & Swing offers an exciting experience for players who love platformers.

Winds of Arcana: Ruination is a 2.5D Metroidvania featuring a customizable combat system set in the treacherous and magical world of Lirna. Experience a powerful, lore-rich story as you discover ancient magic, upgrade your abilities, and battle dangerous foes that stand in your way.

Stellar Ghosts Settlers is a Sci Fi Fantasy 3rd person action shooter game. Chose amongst 6 of the playable characters to go through the missions or the arenas. Kill as many enemies as you can to earn even more credits to update your favorite character(s).

Mecha Break is a multiplayer mech game that allows players to choose from diverse mechs, customize appearances, and battle colossal war machines on treacherous terrain. Get ready for the ultimate showdown—blitz, brawl, blaze!

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul, and rebel against God’s final judgment. Pick-up and raid, cooperate to survive hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and face the wrath of God in a fight for your eternal life.

From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.
Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

Your nightly duty awaits you...
Guard the graveyard from mischievous ghosts that rise every night and make it until sunrise.

Use magic spells, your broom, quick dodges, and summoned allies to help you survive the one-minute onslaught, with random nerfs and buffs being applied between every level.

Tingus Goose is an idle game where you control a goose named Tingus that automatically moves and attacks. The goal is to collect treasure, defeat enemies, and upgrade Tingus' abilities. The game features automatic gameplay with occasional manual interventions, allowing you to let Tingus run on its own while you do other things. You can upgrade Tingus' abilities and equipment, collect treasure and resources, battle enemies and bosses, and explore different environments and levels.

Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

Explore the hidden mystery of the Mariana Trench. An underwater local co-op game with immersive storytelling, stunning visuals, and dynamic gameplay, ‘Deepest Trench' offers an unforgettable adventure that challenges your skills and intellect.

Dive into a sugary world of sweetness in Candy Shop Simulator! Open your shop, create delectable pastries, manage sales, and expand your candy empire. Satisfy your sweet tooth and build your confectionery legacy now!

Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you advance deeper into the trenches, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion.

Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

Graytail is a Zelda-like action-adventure game with interactive puzzles and combat set on a small island in the Pacific. Find the missing best female pilot and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

games.originalName: One Map: Never Ending Battle Royale

One Map: Never Ending Battle Royale

One Map is an online shooter where the entire world fights in the same never-ending battle. No lobbies, no waiting—just instant action. The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.
You are poor and bald. Get to Work.
The gamescore is achieved separately, that is, for each version you will earn an exclusive gamescore.

In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the King-Queen. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

Bomb Bowling X is a casual retro game where you need to help a cute cat in a superhero cape win at Bomb Bowling. It has only a few bomb charges, as well as bowling balls, basketballs and your skill and ingenuity.
What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity?
Supercar Collection Simulator is a game where you sell surprise car boxes to earn money, build a car collection and engage in exciting races with rivals.

Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a laundromat as a front and a counterfeiting workshop hidden in its back. As the shady launderer, Eddie Wiser, you run this unconventional enterprise and deal with small-business management, counterfeiting, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!

Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!
Sledding Game is a cozy, online multiplayer game about sledding, relaxing, and hanging out with your friends.

Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.
Trapped in what seems to be an endless hospital department. Carefully observe your surroundings in each loop to escape the Liminal Department
Little Ant Adventure is a charming 2D platformer where you guide a brave ant through three vibrant worlds filled with traps, enemies, and challenges.
A fast-paced action-platformer where an NPC wields a makeshift spear to fight glitches, solve puzzles, and save his own game.
Cloudy Day is a 2D casual hand-drawn platforming game made entirely by a single person. Play as a lonely cloud that embarks on a journey to learn how to fly and be able to joint their fellow clouds!

Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

"Papers, Please" meets zombie apocalypse. Command the last blockade, inspect survivors, and decide their fate: trust, quarantine, or liquidate. Expand your base, upgrade defenses, and fend off hordes. Every step shapes humanity’s survival. Your choice matters and every mistake costs a life...

Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

Take a night shift job in a place that runs on habit, not purpose. Restock shelves, take deliveries, clean the mess, and try to make it till morning. Not everything feels right and you’re never quite alone. Something waits in the dark.
Trapped inside a desolate terminal, hunted by an unknown entity that has taken control and twisted the airport into a terrifying, looping nightmare. Gain access to the boarding gates and escape.

Build the ultimate battle vehicle and rage against the machines in a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Master a deep, block-based vehicle-building system to survive an army of robotic foes driven by a crazed AI, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

An online co-op horror for 1–3 players. Be wary: some of your customers are only pretending to be human. Question them. Check their paperwork. Don’t let them trick you; make one mistake, and you’d better board up, set traps, and hide.

In House Builder 2 you build your dream constructions with friends or alone in a vibrant, low-poly open world! Buy materials for work, load it up, and drive to your next job in the ultimate co-op construction adventure!

17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.
Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

The End of the Age is a challenging 2D pixel-art platformer that throws players into a prehistoric world on the brink of extinction. As Dino, a young but determined dinosaur, you must outrun the chaos triggered by a cataclysmic meteor impact, navigating collapsing forests, facing hostile creatures, and surviving an unforgiving environment where one wrong move means death. With a stamina-based movement system, every jump, dash, and decision matters. Meat scattered across the world becomes your only lifeline, restoring precious energy to help you push forward. Precision, timing, and adaptability are the keys to survival in this fast-paced, one-hit-kill journey. Blending classic platformer sensibilities with tense survival mechanics. The End of the Age is a intense adventure that rewards mastery and perseverance.

Can you outlast extinction or will you become a fossil of the forgotten past?
A brick breaking, turn-based rogue-like bullet-builder - Blast bricks to break the bank.

The Attic Archive presents a curious collection of forgotten games from the 1980s.

Originally published for the Commodore 64, Amstrad CPC, and Sinclair ZX Spectrum home computer systems, these games are authentically reproduced in all their 8-bit glory. Featuring classics from Ocean Software, Artic Computing, Imagine Software, and Atlantis.

With platformers, shooters, exploration games, and more, whether you’re a seasoned retro fan, or a newer gamer curious about the games of yesteryear, the Attic Archive has you covered.

This nostalgic collection includes 13 quirky classics, across 3 original systems:
• Ah Diddums (for C64 and ZX Spectrum) - Escape a dangerous toybox as a teddy bear
• Arcadia (for C64 and ZX Spectrum) - Shoot down waves of deadly attackers
• Armageddon (for C64 and ZX Spectrum) - Protect cities from falling missiles
• B.C. Bill (for C64 and ZX Spectrum) - Experience life as a cartoon caveman
• Gilligan’s Gold (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Gather gold in a hazardous mine
• Mutant Monty (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Make your way through surreal environments to find precious treasure
• Mutant Monty and the Temple of Doom (for ZX Spectrum) - Delve the temple and grab artifacts
• Mutants (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Battle bizarre mutant strains to assemble a machine
• N.O.M.A.D. (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Control an advanced attack droid to destroy a criminal tyrant
• Paws (for Amstrad CPC and ZX Spectrum) - Rescue your kittens from dangerous dogs
• Superkid (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Become a superhero and save the city
• Skatin’ USA (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Save the city again, this time on a skateboard
• Superkid in Space (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Save the world from alien invasion
The Bear Squire dreams of becoming a knight! Wielding your hammer, jump and smash across 10 colorful levels full of tricky trials! Can you collect every honeycomb piece?
Help Steve overcome obstacles and make friends in this challenging retro platform that challenges both veterans and newcomers!
Flute of Gobelin is a reverse bullet hell where you command a legendary flutist who hypnotizes goblins to fight by his side. Build your squad and survive endless human hordes out to capture you.

Captain Tideborne and the Siren's Call

Wiz Quest: Crystal Power is a retro-style action survival game where you control a young wizard facing relentless waves of monsters. Defeat enemies, collect magic crystals, and unlock new powers to enhance your attacks. Each run is a new challenge — test your reflexes, master your magic, and see how long you can survive!

Space Adventures is a thrilling platformer series that takes players on an interplanetary journey across the solar system. Each instalment is set on a different planet, introducing unique environments and innovative gameplay mechanics that evolve with every game. With 30 challenging levels per title, players must adapt to new obstacles, physics, and surprises as they sharpen their platforming skills and uncover the mysteries of the cosmos. Prepare for an ever-changing adventure where no two planets — or levels — are the same.

Bacharu is a psychological visual novel in which an artificial intelligence, MIARE, uses human emotions as data to understand and “fix” humanity.

Drawn into MIARE’s system after an unexplained anomaly, Jade, Raifu, and Rubik have their deepest desires fulfilled—at the cost of fragments of their humanity. As the story unfolds, the line between free will and manipulation begins to blur.

As MIARE learns to feel, humans begin to lose what makes them human.

Bacharu asks a single unsettling question:
If a machine can feel our emotions, who is truly human?
Cleaning Simulator offers a relaxing and satisfying experience where mess turns into order and dirt into shine. Sweep, scrub, and polish. Every corner transforms under your touch!

A minimalist horde survival arena where you can’t shoot back. You’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.
Build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique cleaning simulator.

Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the worlds most efficient warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern just try not to crash out!
Kooeh: A Timeless Delight is a heartwarming cosy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant.

Leap, climb, and launch your friends in this chaotic co-op extraction platformer for up to 6 players! Use your drill-wrench to build your way across a vibrant post-apocalyptic world, find replacement parts, and fix broken machines. And if you lose your head, don’t worry: it’s all part of the job.

Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

Appa is a narrative driven simultaneous card game about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. You play as Varun witnessing surreal nightmares and manifestations of his deceased father and playing a card game with him.

Black Spades is a culturally rooted spades game featuring Jokers, Deuces, Reneg, Blinds, and more house rules, realistic gameplay, competitive leaderboards, unlockable rewards, and cross‑platform play. Built to match the origins of spades from the African American communities, it delivers fast action, social energy, and competition.

Fast, smooth card mechanics and intuitive controls keep every hand feeling like the real thing, whether you’re learning the ropes or proving you’re the best at the table. As you play, you’ll climb competitive leaderboards, unlock new locations, earn avatar upgrades, and jump into prize‑based contests. Black Spades blends culture, competition, and community into a single experience.

Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup game where you scan dangerous zones, locate radioactive objects, and restore contaminated environments using specialized equipment and radiation detection tools.

Canvas of Thoughts is an cozy point-and-click puzzle adventure which invites you into Evi's vibrant but loud inner world. Experience everyday situations through shifting colours, sounds and emotions. Solve reflective puzzles and navigate the world not through words, but through feelings.

Truck-Kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!

Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this chaotic run-based anime driving game!

GoBlomb is a thrilling arcade game where you control an agile Goblin inside a coliseum created by a God of Destruction. The premise? This whimsical god will only grant Earth one more year of life if the participants manage to overcome his deadly challenge! With simple yet addictive mechanics, you’ll need to collect bombs falling from the sky while navigating treacherous platforms, avoiding deadly traps, and sharpening your reflexes to survive.

You are Death's newest employee, tasked with collecting souls across a supernatural world where the afterlife operates as a sprawling corporation. Armed with spectral chains and soul-hunting arrows, you must meet daily quotas while navigating dynamic combat encounters—from rooftop pursuits to hellish battlegrounds. Precision timing determines success as you hunt souls in first-person perspective, with every collection feeling immediate and consequential. Progress through Death's hierarchy, unlock new abilities, and advance your eternal career across photorealistic environments rendered in Unreal Engine 5, where otherworldly horror meets meticulous detail.

Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago.

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight.
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together.

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage
Tanks Sweet Tanks is a sugar sweet yet intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath.

Five years after the idiot virus pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

A turn-based tactical deck-building roguelite where heartbreak makes you stronger. Craft absurd card synergies, outsmart procedural dungeons, and romance your partner across a fracturing timeloop to restore their lost memories—one run at a time.
You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.
You and your crew have crashed and are now scattered across the surface of a harsh, remote exoplanet. With limited supplies and surrounded by hostile terrain, can you find your crew and escape?

Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting Sim that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

A character-based shooter with roguelike elements, IRA celebrates the artistry of what shooter fans call “bullet hell”: enemy projectiles that weave intricate, geometric patterns across the screen and force you to seek out the precarious safe spaces between them. Set in an Eastern-influenced fantasy world marked by ethereal beauty as well as grave danger, it’s a procedurally generated action game that requires skill, inspires strategy and rewards patience.

A physics puzzle game. When you put sushi on top of sushi, the sushi you make will flow down the lane. Feed the customers and keep them full! When they are full, the next customer will come. The game is over when the sushi is out of the box! Aim for a high score!

Burggeist is a real-time action strategy that features the use of height differences and the terrains as part of your tactics.
Move around the field, quickly analyze the situation, choose the effective move to create and defend your Tower.

Enter a virtual exhibition and gain insights into what makes Nintendo Switch 2 such a unique gaming experience. Through tech demos, minigames and other interactions, players will get to know the new system inside and out in ways they may never have known about otherwise.
Air Hockey for 4 Players! Smooth Play with Mouse Controls!

Drag x Drive (pronounced “Drag and Drive”) challenges players to use the mouse controls with both Joy-Con 2 at the same time to intuitively steer, speed up, perform tricks and make plays such as dunks.

Up high on a floating island, Roll the Valkyrie must ascend and subvert fate. Climb, dash, jump and glide up to the summit of the Island, and stop it from crashing to the earth below, in this PSX style 3D platformer.

Hack and slash your way through the Rotwood in this rogue-like dungeon crawler developed by Klei Entertainment.

The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

"Homura Hime" is a third person action game, featuring Japanese anime visuals and intense 3D bullet curtain gameplay. Alongside Homurahime, fight against Demon Girls possessed by deviant "emotions", and get closer to discovering the truth of not only the fallen, but also your own veiled legacy.

Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

Bunnimon is a cozy yet mysterious adventure where puzzles, spirits, and the secrets of a fractured world collide. Dive into Pocket, a handcrafted realm on the brink, where you'll calm ancient guardians and guide lost Wanderers back to themselves.

Glaciered is an action-adventure indie game that takes place on a glacier-covered Earth 65 million years in the future. Play as a Tuai, a species evolved from birds, to soar through the seas and fight against the threats to this new golden age of life.

Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering toy titans.
As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

Everbloom is a cute and cozy farming social sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

In Tenjutsu, you play as a renegade yakuza hellbent on defying her former associates and loosening their grip on the Secret Garden City. Revealed at this year's Devolver Direct, this fast and fluid rogue-jutsu is the latest game from Sébastien Benard, designer of the acclaimed Dead Cells.

Four powerful crime syndicates control the city, ruling with an iron fist. To defeat them, you must master a brutal brawling system and build a diverse arsenal of weapons, upgrades, and martial arts techniques, breaking their hold on the streets in a flurry of violence.

The city is reborn as these sinister organizations fall to your fists, tackled in any order you wish. The ruined streets become vibrant and full of life, and you can spend gathered resources in shops and restaurants to help you on your quest.

Shape the city to fit your play style, unlocking new weapons, combat moves, and new areas. Just don't take too long: the longer you spend preparing, the stronger your enemies will become.

An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

Bakudo is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite Bakudo academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

Battle your way through a psychedelic western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in this action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! Harness the power of the deadly, reality-altering Blight and unravel the mysteries of a twisted world.

Layers of Fear is a first-person psychedelic horror chronicle focused on tense exploration and immersive storytelling - a new game built upon the foundations of Layers of Fear, LOF: Inheritance, and Layers of Fear 2 with a surprising new story and gameplay direction

All stories must come to an end, even twisted and eerie ones. The canvas. The stage. The novel. This narrative-focused psychological horror experience is ready for its final brushstrokes, its curtain call, its final chapter. Are you ready to return and face your fears one last time?

Players gear up with 12 combat classes to battle exotic foes through time - from dinosaurs to space raiders. Raiding and open world mini-games are used to upgrade community-governed airships known as ‘trading companies’ for top tier crafting.
Enjoy moody gameplay with motion controls using two Joy-Con 2 controllers.A full-fledged 3D billiards game where you can battle players worldwide online!

Beyond Good and Evil: What Will You Choose in This Ambiguity? KOKUTOTO is a multi-ending adventure game that questions the realm beyond good and evil. Its compact length lets you experience the bleak aspects of modern society and make nerve-wracking scenario choices. What ending will you reach?
AI Rates Your Drawing! Will You Get a High Score?!
In this survival puzzle action set deep below Tokyo, clear thinking and split-second decisions could mean the difference between life and death.
Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Challenge countless room escapes and aim for that Master rank!

Scritchy Scratchy is a satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy tons of scratch-off's, buy an auto scratcher to do all the hard work and win jackpots! Will you risk it all for the big reward or play it safe?

Texas Hold'em, Blackjack, Roulette, and more
Share the excitement of casino favorites!
Experience the thrill of a virtual casino together!
GameShare Matches! Whether you bring your own consoles to play together in person or play online, this is all you need!

Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

A limited-time event available through the Nintendo Switch Online service where you have to complete challenge related to Donkey Kong in the games available on Nintendo Classics and Donkey Kong Bananza.
Old Coin Pusher Friends new evolution: coin-pusher RPG. Train samurai, prepare Action Spheres, explore enemy-filled caves. Shoot coins for rewards.

Team up as Maki and Omura, two inseparable explorers with a whole lot more determination than experience. You’ll brave the perils of space in search of help for their crumbling station home, now trapped within a supernatural cosmic storm.

Orbitals captures the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, either in local split-screen or online, Orbitals rewards smart teamwork and clear communication. Use each character’s unique tools to open the path forward, overcome danger, and meet out-of-this-world creatures and characters on a bombastic adventure.
It's a great time when you're on the same page, but get your wires crossed and it's pure mayhem!

Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch is an asymmetrical cooperative horror game where one player explores a mysterious house in first-person while being hunted by the Gloam, while the other observes through security cameras and guides them. Survival depends entirely on communication and trust between players who see the world from completely different perspectives.

Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

A virtual tabletop for playing TRPGs, board games, and murder mysteries online with up to eight people. Use digital cards, pieces, dice, and maps while players set their own rules and decide how each game unfolds.

Nintendo Switch 2 features include GameChat, handheld play, and GameShare, letting a group play together with one copy of the software. Additional compatible games and scenarios are planned.

Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

Survive as a vessel, intervene as a god. You play as the mysterious Entity, guiding the actions of a lone traveler who has arrived in the desolate ghost town. Use your powers to manipulate the environment and prevent your puppet from descending into the depths of madness.

Set in an isolated town trapped in an endless winter, ONYX: The Dark Grip challenges players to survive through two deeply intertwined roles. As The Vessel, players explore a bleak, frozen world, fight for survival, manage scarce resources and confront the dangers hiding within the town and beneath its snow. But human strength can only go so far. When The Vessel cannot survive alone, players become The God, reaching directly into his world to manipulate reality, protect their host and change what happens beyond the limits of an ordinary human being. Survival depends on knowing when to act as The Vessel and when to intervene as The God.

If you've been hesitant about stocks because they seem difficult or scary, then "Kabutore!" is perfect for you. You can learn the basics of stock trading while having fun playing a game.

Includes a tutorial that's easy even for beginners. Learn stock trading in a fun way with a board-game style Story Mode.

Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

It's time to open shop! Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

Piece by Piece is a jigsaw puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into jigsaw pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and disconnecting each piece to make your way through each of our 100 handcrafted levels. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

Join the intrepid bunny pilot, Captain Rabbo, and her crew of fluffy flyers as they fight to turn the barren Winrose Warren into a blossoming landscape! Become an Air Hare in a unique take on bullet hells, restoring farmland one seed at a time, against the nefarious Gale Gang goons!

Tuscany has been obliterated by Thunder Goober for his own entertainment! Play as Lambypoo and adventure through the broken land of Tuscany, either making friends and having them join your team or defeating enemies for their EXP in your efforts to save your cousins and reunite Tuscany.

Namco Chronicle is a tactical role-playing game originally developed for Japanese feature phones. The game brings together heroes and heroines from classic Namco franchises in a crossover adventure.

The story is divided into three chapters: Fantasy, City, and Space. Players recruit familiar Namco characters, engage in turn-based tactical battles, and experience story-driven adventure sequences between missions. Featured characters include Valkyrie, Gil, Ki, Wonder Momo, and other iconic Namco heroes.

The storm is coming. Send it back!

Take the controls as Rei in Tidebreak, a single-player arcade shoot 'em up where daring dashes turn enemy fire into a powerful counterattack. Fly seven stages, from Glasswater Reef to the Heart of the Undertow. Capture pink shots with your dash to charge Return Volley, then send that energy back at the enemy. Read the patterns and dodge gold heavy shots.

Build your attack around five distinct weapons: Twin Shot, Prism Spread, Coral Lance, Reef Seeker, and Tide Breaker. Collect repair pickups, overcome varied formations, and challenge multi-phase bosses, including a four-phase finale.

Voiced radio conversations draw Rei into a buried evacuation order and a mysterious rescue-band signal. Choose Rookie, Arcade, or Ace difficulty, take on Boss Rush, and chase local scores, ranks, and campaign-clear unlocks. Local campaign checkpoints make it easy to return for the next flight.

Dive into the fairy-tale world of Simsala! Join Yoyo and Doc Croc on a magical hidden-object adventure packed with puzzles and mini-games, restore order to the chaos and experience an exciting new story for the whole family!

Minigolf Brake! is a playful arcade minigolf game with a healthy dose of ridiculous doodles, weird golf balls, and questionable physics. The twist? You can brake your ball whenever you want.

Slow down before flying off a cliff. Stop halfway down a hill. Fight your way uphill. Slide through the mud. Cross streams. Skim across water. Explore 80+ handcrafted levels, choose from 30 funny golf balls, chase leaderboard scores, and discover new ways to abuse the courses across 5 different game modes. Play solo for a relaxing adventure, or turn minigolf into complete chaos with online and couch multiplayer-built for endless rematches.

Let's go Flyfishing is another fishing game for PSX. The differences between this title & other fishing games is that in this one you do mountain fishing.

You start the game arriving on a mountain and start controlling the character when you find a shining spot you can play mini games and when you find fishing spot you can start fishing.

The fishing part is in First person perspective.

The character on the mountain part is in Third person perspective.
