Uchi ni Pochi ga Yattekita - in my pocket is a digital pet simulator in which the player takes the role of an elementary school boy or girl that at the beginning have to choose between 5 different dog breeds to grow and raise it. During the game days the player have to take care of the little dog, giving him food, clean him, dress him, he can also punish or caress him, and also take him to the dog to different places of the town like the park, the school, the beach, streets, etc.

The game takes place during a month time that is the time the the player's mother give him as a trial period to take care of the dog. The game also features pocketstation compatibility to see some dogs tricks there.

Mezase! Meimon Yakyuubu is a japanese High School baseball simulation game with cartoon graphics that features more than 4000 schools and a full 3D engine. At the beginning of the game the player can choose the Japan region and after that he can choose one of the schools of that region to choose the high school team he will train. After that the player can choose the tactics, the different weekly training and the tactics during the match.

Base One is a space station simulator with survival and RPG mechanics.

Step into the role of intrepid explorers seeking to build new homes across the far reaches of the cosmos. Establish new colonies by building space stations, managing vital needs like heat, oxygen, and power, while searching for valuable resources in uncharted wilds.
Alone in a forest that won’t let her go, Nora is being followed by an unseen entity that draws closer with every step. A 2D psychological horror with seven endings shaped by your choices.

Build your base on a machine in a constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during a day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

Explore a vast underground world to mine, refine and craft hundreds of items, then build up your modular surface Outpost to farm hydroponic crops, prospect for gems and automate your resource-gathering in this sci-fi survival-crafter where the story always provides a reason to dig deeper.

Azur Promilia is a fantasy world RPG with creature companionship. Step into a fantasy world, utterly different from the world you know. The world of various civilizations, magic and incredible fantasy creatures, together with tales echoing in the starry sky. Take a daring leap from the sky into the ocean, to once again encounter and bond with new life. Guided by shooting stars, amid the sparkling constellations, this is your very own journey. The entire universe eagerly anticipates the ballad of stars and odyssey, exclusively yours to unfold.
Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, and QTE‑style finishers. Traversal options include horseback riding, aerial wire‑grappling, and free‑running across richly detailed environments. Silver Palace is built on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high‑fidelity anime‑inspired visuals and cinematic battle sequences. It will be available on PC, major consoles, iOS, and Android devices with pre‑registration now open for global audiences. The title adopts a free‑to‑play model enhanced by gacha mechanics for character and gear progression. An 11‑minute gameplay showcase has been released, offering a deep dive into the game’s mechanics and world‑building. No firm release date has been announced, but further details and developer updates will be shared via the official website and social channels.

ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character's attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life.

A co-op game where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog. Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

Village romance hotter than summer's heat! Drowning in debt, you escape to the countryside only to meet the loan shark noona, your first love, and the tsundere village princess! This summer, your heart’s melting faster than ice cream. Who’s going to set your world on fire?

Enjoy classic Sudoku with clean, focused puzzle gameplay and competitive features built for quick sessions or serious leaderboard chasing.

Choose from Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels, each with its own dedicated leaderboard. Whether you want a relaxed puzzle session or a tougher logic challenge, you can play at your own pace and compete for the fastest completion time in each category.
An indie fighting game released on the Xbox Live Marketplace. It was re-released in 2011 with online multiplayer support.
An edutainment/platform game for Xbox Live Indie Games platform. Players go around the maps looking for letters.

The cats are back to win your heart - and your vote in Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution, a satirical otome game! With a script that's over 100,000 words long, Cat President 2 is a visual novel packed full of romance, humor and cute pictures of cats. Fans of the first game and newcomers alike are sure to enjoy this game! Cast your vote today!

In this puzzle-platform game, you must make mistakes in order to progress. Place blocks when you fail, and shape the level in your favor. Discover how to use blocks with different effects to escape from within yourself while learning to live with your mistakes.

Spellthief Erinn is a 2D Puzzle Platformer where you take control of the enemies magic attacks and use them to your advantage. Solve the misteries, explore the enviroment and reach the chest with a hidden spell. Find, steal and collect them all!
The sequel to everyone's favorite single-player adventure set on the internet about our digital lives.

Journey through a large open world with a party of heroes exploring dungeons, villages and mysteries. Manage an adventuring party of heroes and choose the way their stories evolve as they journey through a non linear epic adventure towards the ultimate Lair of the Leviathan.

In Anomaly Hunter - Observation Duty, you're not just a security guard; you're the last line of defense against the unexplained. With only security cameras as your eyes, witness eerie movements and unsettling whispers echoing in the shadows.
Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.
Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,276 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

Honey Route is a relaxing path-connection puzzle set inside a beehive.

Rotate the hexagonal honeycomb pieces to build continuous honey trails, guiding every worker bee to a queen. Start with a single bee and a single queen, and work your way up to huge hives where many bees and many queens share the same network. One bee can reach several queens, and several bees can reach the same queen.

There is no timer, no lives, no score and no penalty. Try any rotation you like and solve each level at your own pace. Visual and sound feedback shows every connection as it forms, so you always know how close you are to completing the hive.

The 30 handcrafted levels grow steadily in size and challenge, ending in boards with up to 388 pieces, 28 bees and 28 queens.

Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

In Love Love Mystery Club, you’re the newest member of the Detective Club at a seemingly ordinary high school. Through Full Motion Video (FMV) storytelling, your choices steer the narrative—will your heart find tenderness… or will hidden horrors emerge from the darkness?

Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps.
In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?
A fast-paced tower defense strategy with settlement management. Build, assign villagers, empower the lighthouse, and keep the light alive until the final wave.

Gravhounds is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow. The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!
Tidy up 4970 products your cat knocked off the shelves!
Pro Yakyuu Nettou Puzzle Stadium is a Puzzle game, published by Coconuts Japan, which was released in Japan in 1997.

The 240p test suite is a homebrew software suite for video game consoles developed to help in the evaluation of capture cards, upscalers, upscan converters, line doublers and of course TV processing of 240p video and scaled signals.

Twin Peaks: Meanwhile is a short re imagining of the classic 90s show as if it was made into a Game Boy game. The game is completely centered around Cooper's adventure into the black lodge. There is multiple endings and a host of spirits to interact with.
Deadly horrors fill the world. To survive in this demonic world, you have to kill everything that moves. You will visit different parts of the world, from ancient destroyed cities to forest fringes.

A turn-based tactical RPG set in Gensokyo. Renko and Merry are separated the moment they stumble into this strange land. Build a party from a wide Touhou cast, raise them freely through Reincarnation and added skills, and follow a story that branches into three routes.

Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!
Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals.

Tokyo, 202X. On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives. You don't recognize the sender's name, but the return address bears the name of a village that was supposed to have vanished...

A visual novel adventure game focusing on a player who is a regular high school student who one day stumbles upon a special stone that grants him the ability to turn into a cat at will. Using it for evil things or stopping to use it at all will invite bad luck into his life, so he decides to use for getting to know girls he would be too shy to approach as a regular boy.

Become a mischievous ghost in this physics-powered puzzle adventure where you push, drop, and explode your way through 14 challenging levels. Use your spectral powers to manipulate boxes, bombs and doors to eliminate enemies in creative ways. With its vibrant cartoon style and strategic stamina-based gameplay, Specter Smash delivers brain-teasing puzzles that reward clever thinking over quick reflexes.
Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands.

Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.

Exzisus is a 1987 horizontally scrolling shooter video game developed and published by Taito for arcades. It was released in North America by TAD Corporation. The player controls a giant robot that can transform into a space-ship or be accompanied by robotic animal helpers in an attempt to free four planets from a mechanical enemy.

A character-deduction puzzle game where you identify a hidden suspect by asking yes-or-no questions about appearance, clothing, and accessories. Study a lineup of 18 faces and use each clue carefully to narrow down the possibilities.

Cases feature a rotating cast of 50 illustrated characters with animated portraits, voice acting, and banter. In campaign mode, build a streak through increasingly challenging cases, earn rewards, and use bonus powers while managing three lives.
Vampire Slayer is a fast and furious multiplayer team game that pits the stealth and speed of Vampires against the weaponry of the Slayers. There are bots for singleplayer too.

Saturn 9 is a sci-fi horror adventure where you are sent to investigate a spaceship after all communication is lost. Solve puzzles and explore the ship to uncover the mystery of what happened to the crew.

Become a Space Mechanic! Get your hands dirty, explore the depths of space and repair broken machinery. Diagnose problems using diagrams and tools, perform repairs, manage your resources and watch the simulated machinery come alive. Or just gaze upon the beauty of the Solar System.

Investigating a simple robbery reveals a tapestry of mysteries!

Solve a series of cases as newly hired police clerk Justina Smith and find out the truth behind a string of suspicious crimes. Work with the energetic detective Ernest Hunt and dig for clues in the paper trail to discover the secrets that paperwork can hide.
An action-packed holiday adventure full of pirates, snowballs, and the occasional yeti. Explore the North Pole in this third-person action adventure game for all ages.

Dash and survive in a grid-like world filled with colored light cubes, lasers, and portals, each with unique mechanics. Play, die, and repeat to master the fastest path to the finish. Time is not on your side.

In this thrilling 2D platformer, you play as a brave astronaut stranded on a mysterious alien planet after a failed mission. Your only hope of escape lies in collecting powerful energy cores hidden across treacherous levels.
Two soldiers. A connection they never fully acknowledge. One final mission that changes everything.

The Last Knight is a 2.5D voxel-based sidescroller blending fast combat, strategic platforming, and dark fantasy.

Fun, engaging and straight to the point 3D platformer! Run, double jump and spin as the gentle Bobobby rushing through 20 levels across tropical islands! You don't actually have to rush, as there's no time limit, so play your own way!

Get ready for a charming springtime adventure in Bunny Pit Berry. Take control of an adorable hamster and use your wits to push delicious fruits into the picnic basket, solving increasingly clever puzzles along the way.

KeyQuack Quest is a pixel art platformer where you control a clever mallard on a mission to collect keys, avoid deadly traps, and reach the exit door. With progressively challenging levels, precise mechanics, and a charming retro aesthetic, the game blends action and strategy across carefully designed stages. Players will be drawn in by KeyQuack Quest’s fun and engaging experience, featuring responsive controls and levels that demand planning and smart decision-making. Additionally, the charismatic protagonist and pixelated style create a nostalgic and immersive atmosphere.

Math Duck+ is a puzzle‑platformer where you must collect the correct numbered blocks to complete each equation while avoiding hazards and racing against the clock. Solve all the equations to reveal the key, then grab it and reach the exit before time runs out.

A puzzle adventure about guiding José the Cat through dangerous jungle trails in his jeep. On each level, arrange and rotate path tiles on a hexagonal grid to build a route to the goal, positioning geysers and planning around fragile paths.

Once the drive begins, control your speed to dodge erupting geysers and cross breakable routes safely. Each level challenges you to plan ahead and react at the right moment.

In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.
Travel across Australia behind the wheel of the mighty Road Train! Haul extreme cargo thousands of miles and explore the Outback's wilderness in some of the most intense conditions on earth!

Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

Bid, win and then sell for profit as you work your way up from the bottom to become the king or queen of the storage auction. Take risks and fight for garages amongst fierce competition as you compete with other bidders to find hidden treasures that will help you turn a profit.
Explore abyssal mazes as a jellyfish in a retro 1-bit puzzle — find the key, unlock the door, and dive ever deeper.
Run and expand your own medieval shop! Sell weapons, armor, food, and rare goods to peasants and lords alike in the immersive medieval store simulator.

Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

The heart of the universe is shattered! Join Bo and Kikki to rescue Starlits across mysterious worlds. Master 20 suits to explore and fight. Rebuild your home in this cozy adventure. Save the universe with heart!

Petit Planet is HoYoverse's brand-new cosmic life sim that's free-to-play and cross-platform. Here, you can build your home, live alongside fuzzy neighbors, and discover the infinite possibilities of life on this planet!
